description: This Java source file defines the TcpConnector class, which implements networking functionality to establish a TCP connection to a specified host and port. It manages connection setup, data transmission, and response handling for a protocol-based communication. The class includes methods for parsing port and hostname information, attempting connections, and sending commands over an established link.

classes.name: TcpConnector
classes.description: Implements TCP connection logic, including connection establishment, data communication, and error handling as part of the LinkConnector interface.

classes.name: TcpConnector.InvalidTcpPort
classes.description: Custom exception class used to indicate invalid TCP port format.

methods.name: TcpConnector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TCP connector with a host and port, parsing port string to integer and hostname.

methods.name: isTcpPort
methods.description: Checks if a given port string is valid and represents a TCP port.

methods.name: getTcpPort
methods.description: Parses the port from a string, handling optional hostname:port format; throws InvalidTcpPort on failure.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Extracts hostname from a port string, defaulting to localhost if not specified.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a TCP connection to the target host and port, setting up data listeners and protocol handlers.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Placeholder method for restarting the connection; currently empty.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Indicates whether the connection has encountered an error; always returns false in current implementation.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Returns the input packet string as-is; placeholder for protocol-specific unpacking logic.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command string over the established TCP connection via the BinaryProtocol, throws if not connected.

methods.name: getAvailablePorts
methods.description: Returns a list with the default TCP port if the port is open, otherwise empty.

methods.name: isTcpPortOpened
methods.description: Checks if the default TCP port is open and accessible on localhost.
